name: 2019-1c-parcial2-extendido
title: Personal and Team Calendars (extended)
description: Extended variant of the calendar exam: hierarchical individual and team calendars with one-off, periodically repeating and weekday-repeating events, availability queries, and a first-free-spot search with a configurable minute increment that skips given weekdays. The student must build the model from scratch with TDD.

design.notes: Adds a third event kind (weekday-based repetition) to the polymorphic event hierarchy and makes the spot search parametric in increment and excluded weekdays, so the search must be designed as a reusable object rather than a hard-coded hourly loop.
